comparison.objective: Move the remaining tissue roll to the reserve position, install a refill, close and latch the dispenser, and leave connected tissue accessible; candidate separates loose ceramic media from steel washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-roll placement over spindles, spring-lug engagement, cover/panel/latch operation and deformable tissue-tail preservation versus balanced tab grasps, load sharing, orientation-sensitive sifting and controlled reseating.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires correctly seated rolls, shut/bolted cover, correct outlet selection, an attached and measurably accessible tissue edge, settled hardware and robot clearance, with fall/misplacement failures. Candidate instead grades recovered media mass, complete washer retention, spill/damage avoidance, support seating, clearance and 3 s dwell.
comparison.reason: Both preserve one item while manipulating others, but the tested abilities differ materially: dispenser restocking and deformable-sheet accessibility versus size-selective rigid-body separation through a screen. The available versions provide sufficient thresholds for distinction.
